# PR15 forum-identity spec v2.32 (engineer-safe; REFERENCE)

v2.32 = v2.31 plus reference rows S-349 to S-351, with proposed bindingFrom r5w. No binding row changes: v2.31 (46ad8131) stays the binding spec from r5v (8c-49). v2.31 is left unedited.

## Oracle
The oracle is v2.31 plus addendum 8c supplement 10 (8c-48; file sha ca95093c…). Supplement 9 (8c-44 to 8c-47) needs no oracle change:
- SUBJECT is already a class word in the oracle;
- 'her' after a preposition is already content;
- S-328 already carries qualified.

The changes and checks:
- **8c-48.** 8c-40 is general. Wherever the setting's own committee is matched, whether at an own heading above a neutral leaf or as the leaf itself, a heading naming a different specific committee (listed, or named under 8b-1 / 8c-7) caps the result to qualified. Generic, structural and whole-House-family headings do not cap.
- **Zero drift** on any v2.16 or v2.21–v2.31 row, in either portion, on the corpus matrix v1.2 and on the self-match.
